title: Synthesis and structures of fluoride-bridged dysprosium clusters: influence of fluoride ions on magnetic relaxation behaviors

synthesis.procedure: Under argon (glovebox or Schlenk), an equivalent of Et3N·HF was added very slowly to a cold THF solution of [Cp'3Dy] (Cp' = C5H4SiMe3). After filtration and solvent removal, crystallization from toluene gave 1Dy. The paper states that the protonation level depends on the crystallization solvent and the Et3N·HF/[Cp'3Dy] ratio and refers the experimental quantities to the ESI. Et3N·HF itself was made by mixing Et3N·3HF with two equivalents of Et3N; THF and toluene were dried.
synthesis.temperature: cold THF solution; manipulations otherwise at room temperature
synthesis.time: stirred 24 h; crystallization for several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: argon glovebox or Schlenk; slow addition, filtration, solvent removal, crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, remove solvent, crystallize the raw product from toluene to give 1Dy·toluene.

properties.summary: 1Dy shows slow magnetization relaxation (SMM) between 2 and 10 K. Zero-field relaxation was fit to Orbach, Raman and QTM processes (Ueff = 87 K); under 1.5 kOe the QTM term is suppressed and Ueff = 95 K. The abstract quotes a 95 K barrier. χmT decreases on cooling, consistent with Stark-level depopulation and low-temperature antiferromagnetic interactions. The thermo-assisted relaxation is attributed to the {Cp'2Dy} fragment; the calculated blocking barrier is 80 K (55.8 cm−1).

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same slow addition of an equivalent of Et3N·HF to cold THF [Cp'3Dy], followed by filtration and solvent removal. Crystallization from hexane, rather than toluene, afforded tetranuclear 2Dy with a disordered hexane in the lattice. Detailed quantities are stated to be in the ESI.
synthesis.temperature: cold THF solution; manipulations otherwise at room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: argon glovebox or Schlenk; slow addition, filtration, solvent removal, crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, remove solvent, crystallize from hexane to give 2Dy·hexane.

properties.summary: 2Dy is an SMM with ac relaxation below 10 K, in a similar temperature window to 1Dy. Zero-field Orbach+Raman+QTM fitting gives Ueff = 89 K; a 2 kOe field gives Ueff = 97 K (the abstract rounds the barrier to 98 K). Calculated single-ion barriers for Dy3 and Dy4 are 162 K and 166 K and differ from experiment, which is ascribed to weak coupling. Relaxation is again associated with [Cp'2Dy(μ-F)2] motifs.

synthesis.procedure: In the same {Cp'3Dy + Et3N·HF} system used for 1Dy/2Dy, the molar ratio of [Cp'3Dy] to Et3N·HF was changed to 1:1.5. The heptanuclear cluster 3Dy (C64H110Dy7F15O4Si6·hex) was obtained after fine-tuning the reaction and crystallization conditions. Manipulations were under argon; THF and hexane were dried. Absolute masses, time and isolated yield are not given in the main text.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: argon glovebox or Schlenk; stoichiometry changed to 1:1.5
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallization conditions were adjusted to isolate 3Dy as a hexane solvate; no further work-up detail in the main text.

properties.summary: 3Dy shows dc susceptibility and magnetization typical of weakly coupled Dy(III) ions, but no frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac peaks in any applied field, so it is not an SMM. Extra fluoride coordination is said to disrupt the [Cp'2Dy]+ motifs that cause relaxation in 1Dy and 2Dy.

synthesis.procedure: The hydroxide-bridged dinuclear complex 4Dy was prepared by a method similar to the fluoride-cluster reactions for comparison of OH versus F bridges. No reagent amounts, solvent quantities, time or yield for 4Dy are given in the main text.

reagents.name: toluene
reagents.amount: 10 mL for the water solution; 2 mL for crystallization

synthesis.temperature: addition and stirring at −20 °C; crystallization at −25 °C
synthesis.time: stirred overnight; crystallization for several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: similar method to the fluoride clusters; argon atmosphere for the general manipulations
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Precipitate collected by filtration and dried under vacuum; solid dissolved in 2 mL toluene and stored at −25 °C for several days to give colorless single crystals.

properties.summary: 4Dy was measured for comparison with the fluoride clusters. It shows the usual decrease of χmT on cooling and anisotropic magnetization, but no frequency-dependent ac susceptibility and no obvious slow relaxation under zero field.
